name: Open Plunge
description: Pull the edge across the target from heel to tip in one straight forward draw.

name: Square Peel
description: Drive the point forward from a bent elbow into an unguarded line of the body.

name: Hooding Bolster
description: Turn the flat of the blade along the forearm to knock an incoming strike aside.

name: Shifting Choil
description: Slide one foot forward as the blade cuts so the user closes the gap without overreaching.

name: Stopping Edgebelly
description: Tap the opponent's wrist with the blunt spine to loosen their grip on a weapon.

name: Deep Tangpin
description: Hold a still guard with the point low while reading the opponent's shifts of weight.

name: Choildrop
description: Pull the knife from the belt and cut across the target in a single motion.

name: Descending Thumbramp
description: Hold the blade edge outward along the forearm and hook it across an opponent's arm or flank.

name: Angled Scales
description: Raise the sheathed knife across the ribs to stop a blow aimed at the user's side.

name: Sideways Whittle
description: Swing the hips off the line of attack and slash on the same breath.

name: Short Shave
description: Lay the thumb along the spine and press the edge down through a cloth or leather guard.

name: Locking Buttcap
description: Catch the opponent's sleeve in the heel notch to pin the arm for a moment.

name: Lanyard Lid
description: Wrap the wrist lanyard around an outstretched wrist and pull to cramp the opponent's reach.

name: Downward Pare
description: Hold the handle like a hammer and bring the edge down in a short chopping arc.

name: Short Swedge
description: Hold the edge forward with the thumb on the spine and draw it across the target.

name: Plunge Hit
description: Hold the blade point down and drop it from above into a shoulder or back line.

name: Straight Pare
description: Hold the handle with the first finger forward and thrust along a straight line to the target.

name: Turning Lanyard
description: Flip the knife between grips in the open hand so the opponent misreads the next cut.

name: Leaden Trim
description: Sweep the curved belly of the edge across the target in a long shallow arc.

name: Hard Slit
description: Set the point shallow and pull it back toward the user to open clothing and light armor.

name: Square Whittle
description: Drag the rounded belly of the blade along the target so a light cut follows the curve.

name: Trimhusk
description: Roll the wrist under an opponent's arm and peel their guard open with the blade flat.

name: Narrow Swedge
description: Slip the narrow tip through a gap between armor plates or garment layers.

name: Slitblow
description: Set the edge on a joint line at the elbow or wrist and cut inward.

name: Thumbramp Wedge
description: Lay the broad blade across the forearm and wrist as a shield against slashes.

name: Plungenote
description: Plant the feet wide and keep the elbows in while reading the opponent's body for openings.

name: Plungestrike
description: Shave the edge along the target in a short controlled stroke that peels the surface.

name: Choil Strike
description: Push the spine with the thumb of the other hand to drive a short hard chip cut.

name: Choilhit
description: Pull the edge inward along the target while the free hand holds it steady.

name: Plungedash
description: Push the edge outward along the target while the elbow stays braced against the ribs.

name: Peelcowl
description: Cut two crossing short lines into a wrist or gloved hand to break the opponent's hold.

name: Settled Buttcap
description: Turn the edge down and shave aside a blow with a short outward wrist turn.

name: Sharp Slit
description: Draw the knife across the body from the opposite hip and cut as it clears the sheath.

name: Blunt Trim
description: Pull the knife from a back-carried sheath and cut outward behind the user.

name: Shave Strike
description: Pull the knife downward from a chest sheath and cut through the opponent's reach.

name: Blunt Bolster
description: Rise from a crouch with the boot-carried knife and thrust upward into the target.

name: Swedgestay
description: Use the sheath and its strap as a short guard to turn a blow off the user's line.

name: Swedgehop
description: Drop the weight and step back out of reach while keeping the point toward the foe.

name: Plungecount
description: Return the blade to its sheath by feel while the eyes stay on the opponent.

name: Firm Peel
description: Flick the folded blade open and cut in one motion with a thread of qi along the edge.

name: Forward Shave
description: Press the locked spine down with the thumb and cut with the edge warmed by qi.

name: Plungeblow
description: Hide the handle in the palm and jab the point through a gap in the guard.

name: Trimcowl
description: Strike a nerve point with the closed handle to numb the opponent's hand for a breath.

name: Folded Edgebelly
description: Brace the open blade against the forearm with qi in the spine to stop a cut.

name: Swedgeskitter
description: Step back and fold the blade away in one smooth motion to end the exchange.

name: Swedgestrike
description: Chain three short cuts in a row with qi carried lightly along the working edge.

name: Sharp Lanyard
description: Slash through straps and light cord with the edge set to saw across the fibres.

name: Flat Tangpin
description: Hook the blade under a strap and pull it taut until the edge severs it.

name: Swedge Drop
description: Pierce a sack or padded coat with the point and tear a short split along the seam.

name: Locking Peel
description: Drive the tip into a joint between armor plates and pry to pop the fastening.

name: Gnawing Trim
description: Punch the point straight through leather straps and thin hide in one hard push.

name: Kept Bolster
description: Angle the broad flat of the blade against a blow and let it slide off.

name: Slitdodge
description: Shift a steady wide stance step by step while qi settles into the legs.

name: Quick Pare
description: Cut forward from the guard with the edge leading and qi laid thin along it.

name: Scalesdash
description: Drive the clipped point upward under the opponent's guard from a low crouch.

name: Pushing Edgebelly
description: Catch an incoming blade against the crossguard and hold it from sliding down.

name: Plungewedge
description: Sweep the blade across the line of attack to turn a thrust aside.

name: Choil Stay
description: Press the empty lead hand against the opponent's weapon arm to cramp the next cut.

name: Buttcap Skitter
description: Shuffle both feet forward in small steps to enter the knife's short range.

name: Scalesdrop
description: Draw the whole edge across the target in a patient long stroke with light qi.

name: Swedgehit
description: Turn the tip in a small spiral to gouge cloth leather or flesh near the surface.

name: Short Plunge
description: Press the tip in at a shallow slant and lever it to open a seam.

name: Descending Tangpin
description: Cut small repeated notches into one spot on a weapon haft until it weakens.

name: Parelid
description: Score a thin line across the opponent's grip hand to make them flinch open.

name: Hooding Edgebelly
description: Tilt the wrist to turn an incoming edge off the hand with the flat.

name: Swaying Slit
description: Pivot on the back heel to close the distance while the blade stays tucked.

name: Single Thumbramp
description: Skim a film of circulating qi along the edge and draw it across the target.

name: Swedgeblow
description: Hold the edge against the target while qi keeps it warm and biting through leather.

name: Level Tangpin
description: Send a pulse of qi to the tip as it pokes into a guard gap.

name: Planted Plunge
description: Match slow breaths to a steady blade guard while qi firms the forearm.

name: Warm Scales
description: Let qi in the edge sense the opponent's blade angle and pressure through contact.

name: Downward Swedge
description: Bring the broad heavy edge down in a chopping slash backed by light qi.

name: Level Scales
description: Drive the thick edge in at a slant and wedge it to split the target's guard.

name: Slitdrop
description: Pull the deep belly of the blade through the target with the whole forearm.

name: Plungebump
description: Slice long and level through padded armor in a single drawing pull.

name: Thumbramp Lid
description: Meet a strike with the thick back of the blade and shed it sideways.

name: Light Peel
description: Hold a firm square stance and step in measured paces while the blade stays low.

name: Wide Buttcap
description: Sweep the long edge in a wide arc to keep the opponents back from the user.

name: Stepping Pare
description: Cut across the front and step clear before the counterstroke can land.
